tasks.corrected_reference_answer: There is no such execution-versus-documentation classification here. ModuleAnalyzer.analyze extracts comments, annotations, overloads and definition tags (sphinx/pycode/__init__.py:136-160). viewcode has_tag records the documenting page in used[fullname], not whether a function executes (sphinx/ext/viewcode.py:120-147). An empty function cannot be classified as documentation-only from those records.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: PyClasslike.get_index_text branches on objtype: classes use translated built-in/module-context templates, exceptions return the bare name, and other types return an empty string (sphinx/domains/python/__init__.py:216-224). The translation proxy resolves gettext in __str__ (sphinx/locale/__init__.py:33-38); its __mod__ invokes that during percent interpolation (70-71). Thus get_index_text already returns the formatted string, rather than deferring translation until index insertion.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Each testing parse call creates an RSTParser and calls _parse_str_to_doctree with registry transforms (sphinx/testing/restructuredtext.py:14-46). That helper creates a document and transformer, parses the text and applies reader, supplied and parser transforms (sphinx/util/docutils.py:837-896). assert_node recursively checks the supplied shape and attributes (sphinx/testing/util.py:31-75). These are candidate repeated costs; the code alone does not establish a bottleneck or quantify slowdown. Profile representative tests before reusing parsed trees, since parsing and transforms mutate document/environment state.

material_errors: False inherited parallel flag; pickling does not promise stable filename IDs across runs.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: make_id caches names within the builder and generates epub-N on a miss; init resets the cache (sphinx/builders/_epub_base.py:165-190). Environment pickling copies state and restores it, but does not persist the builder cache or promise stable filename-to-ID assignment across runs (sphinx/environment/__init__.py:241-253). Preserved counters would advance rather than regenerate previous values. The claim that parallel processing is disabled is false: StandaloneHTMLBuilder sets allow_parallel=True (sphinx/builders/html/__init__.py:110-119). make_id itself has no lock, so these snippets provide no general concurrent-access guarantee.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: First distinguish alias handling from repeated parsing. Napoleon registers paramtype and kwtype for its keyword field (sphinx/ext/napoleon/__init__.py:352-360). DocFieldTransformer resolves each tag through typemap, then stores content under types[typedesc.name][fieldarg]; repeated keys overwrite rather than retain two types (sphinx/util/docfields.py:387-448). The cited fixture tests separate arguments, not duplicate tags on one argument (tests/roots/test-ext-napoleon-paramtype/pkg/foo.py:4-28). If profiling establishes duplicate work, normalize aliases to that existing logical key and optionally skip identical content while preserving defined conflict precedence. A check at this stage cannot avoid initial reStructuredText parsing because field nodes already exist.
